items.difficulty_reason: H2: the source-local proof requires filtered Schwartz-kernel composition and symbol control, exact projector construction from approximate symbols, normalization of a symbol partial isometry within the Toeplitz calculus, and stable comparison with twisted spin-c quantization. The main result is not obtained by merely plugging data into a pre-assumed Riemann–Roch formula; that model index is only the last external step.
